title: Graphiti: Shannon Entropy Gate, 32-Perm MinHash/LSH Entity Deduplication & Dangling Endpoint Pruning
summary: Graphiti filters low-specificity entity names using character Shannon entropy (_NAME_ENTROPY_THRESHOLD=1.5, _MIN_NAME_LENGTH=6, _MIN_TOKEN_COUNT=2) before fuzzy matching, sending ambiguous names to LLM resolution. High-entropy names convert to 3-gram shingles, 32-permutation 64-bit blake2b MinHash signatures, and 4-band LSH buckets verified at Jaccard >= 0.9, promoting merged labels via _promote_resolved_node(). Missing edge endpoints are materialized and later pruned via prune_unreferenced_materialized_nodes().

references.description: Shannon entropy gate (_name_entropy/_has_high_entropy), 3-gram shingles, 32-perm blake2b MinHash, 4-band LSH, and label promotion

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Gate MinHash/LSH Jaccard entity deduplication behind character Shannon entropy thresholds and clean up materialized dangling edge endpoints that lose surviving references.
